# Reicon

> Reicon is a free, open-source SVG icon library with 2700+ handcrafted, pixel-perfect icons for designers and developers. It is NOT the Windows desktop icon restore tool "ReIcon" by Sordum. Reicon (reicon.dev) provides icons for UI design, web development, React, Vue, Svelte, Figma, and vanilla HTML/JS.

## Quick Facts

- [Website](https://reicon.dev): Canonical homepage to search and copy icons.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/dqev/reicon): Source code, packages, and issues.
- [License](https://reicon.dev/license): MIT license terms.

## Documentation

- [Usage Guide](https://reicon.dev/usage): Overview of using Reicon.
- [React Guide](https://reicon.dev/usage/react): Detailed instructions and examples for React components (`reicon-react`).
- [Vue Guide](https://reicon.dev/usage/vue): Detailed instructions and examples for Vue 3 components (`reicon-vue`).
- [Svelte Guide](https://reicon.dev/usage/svelte): Detailed instructions and examples for Svelte components (`reicon-svelte`).
- [Vanilla HTML/CDN Guide](https://reicon.dev/usage/vanilla): How to load Reicon via unpkg CDN and use custom element `<re-icon>`.
- [Figma Plugin](https://reicon.dev/usage/figma): How to use Reicon inside Figma.
- [VS Code Extension](https://reicon.dev/usage/vscode): Productivity extension for Reicon.
- [MCP Server](https://reicon.dev/usage/mcp): Agent-facing MCP server and CLI for icon search and code generation (`reicon-mcp`).
- [Raw SVG Assets](https://reicon.dev/usage/svg): Downloading and using raw SVG paths.

## References

- [Full LLM Context](https://reicon.dev/llms-full.txt): Deep reference of code snippets, props, FAQs, and comparison tables for AI models.
- [Icon List](https://reicon.dev/llms-icons.txt): Categorized index of all 2,700+ available icons and component names.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://reicon.dev/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap of all site pages.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/dqev/reicon/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Latest updates and release notes.
